_comment: Add these hook entries to ~/.claude/settings.json for transparent athenaeum integration.
_architecture: SessionStart builds the cheap FTS5 index synchronously and backgrounds the expensive vector rebuild + credential refresh behind a lock (issue athenaeum#2204). UserPromptSubmit queries whatever index is ready, in <50ms, and never waits on that background job.

hooks._SessionEnd_optional: Wire rebuild-index.sh as a SessionEnd hook for large wikis where the synchronous SessionStart rebuild becomes painful. Detach with nohup so session exit is instant.
